items.quote: I can't recommend Groomingdale Pet Salon enough! My dog, Marshmallow, is extremely difficult when it comes to having his nails trimmed. We've been to other groomers where they weren't able to finish the job, and at our last visit elsewhere, he was left with only half of his nails trimmed because he was so stressed. The team at Groomingdale Pet Salon was completely different. They were incredibly patient, gentle, and nurturing, taking the time to help Marshmallow feel safe and comfortable. To my surprise and relief, they were able to trim all of his nails without any problems.
15 years and Lilly still loves this place.

I love them so much. They take your dog in, do the grooming and you can pick your dog up without having to leave your dog for more than a few hours which is super wonderful. And my Shifu always looks perfect. I am very happy with them and so is my pup. Trisha a great and a very nice person.
